scope: Active P1/P2/P3 only. Note: Sanofi is a multinational pharma with ~77 clinical-stage projects per company disclosures (including ~28 Phase 3, ~28 Phase 2, ~15 Phase 1, plus 6 in registration). Detail below covers flagship late-stage assets only; full asset-level enumeration would require parsing the company's complete pipeline tracker.

10k.error: Foreign private issuer — files 20-F instead of 10-K. SEC EDGAR returned no 10-K for CIK 0001121404 in recent filings.

website.summary: 77 clinical-stage projects, 34 in Phase 3 or submitted to regulatory authorities. Distribution: 15 P1 / 28 P2 / 28 P3 / 6 Registration.

indications.indication: Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD), former smokers, type 2 inflammation
indications.trial_name: AERIFY-1 / AERIFY-2 (Phase 3 COPD program); AERIFY-LT long-term safety extension
indications.trial_design: Two pivotal Phase 3 randomized placebo-controlled studies; primary endpoint reduction in moderate/severe acute exacerbations.
indications.trial_status: AERIFY-1 met primary endpoint; AERIFY-2 did not meet primary endpoint; long-term safety study active.
key_milestones: Phase 3 in chronic rhinosinusitis with nasal polyps (CRSwNP) initiated Q1 2025.

indications.trial_name: SHORE / COAST 2 Phase 3 atopic dermatitis program
indications.trial_design: Randomized placebo-controlled Phase 3; primary and key secondary endpoints in moderate-to-severe AD.
indications.trial_status: Met all primary and key secondary endpoints (SHORE); COAST 2 monotherapy met Week 24 primary endpoint.
key_milestones: Positive Phase 3 readouts in atopic dermatitis (2025).
Additional Phase 3 programs in asthma, hidradenitis suppurativa, alopecia areata.

pipeline.modality: Small molecule, brain-penetrant Bruton's tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitor

indications.trial_name: HERCULES / GEMINI 1 / GEMINI 2 / PERSEUS Phase 3 program
indications.trial_design: Randomized active/placebo-controlled Phase 3 studies in MS subtypes.
indications.trial_status: FDA issued Complete Response Letter for nrSPMS NDA. PERSEUS in primary progressive MS did not meet primary endpoint; Sanofi will not pursue PPMS submission. HERCULES (nrSPMS) positive — being addressed.
key_milestones: PERSEUS missed primary endpoint in PPMS (2025).

pipeline.modality: Small molecule, reversible covalent BTK inhibitor (oral)

indications.trial_design: Randomized placebo-controlled Phase 3 in adults with persistent or chronic ITP.
indications.trial_status: Filed for approval (per Sanofi pipeline disclosures); Phase 3 met primary endpoint.
key_milestones: FDA Fast Track Designation for IgG4-related disease.
FDA Orphan Drug Designation for vaso-occlusive crises in sickle cell disease.
Additional Phase 3 programs in chronic spontaneous urticaria, asthma.

indications.indication: Inflammatory indication (specific indication undisclosed in pipeline summary)
Inflammatory indication (specific indication undisclosed in pipeline summary)

commercial_product.note: Sanofi has an extensive marketed portfolio (Dupixent, Aubagio, Lemtrada, vaccine franchise including Beyfortus, ALTUVIIIO, etc.) outside the scope of this active P1-P3 enumeration.

excluded_legacy_terminated: Tolebrutinib in PPMS (PERSEUS) — failed primary endpoint, will not be submitted.

summary_counts.note: Listed assets are flagship/representative. Sanofi disclosed pipeline includes 28 Phase 3, 28 Phase 2, 15 Phase 1, 6 Registration projects (77 total). Full asset-level enumeration was not feasible from the public pipeline page within agent constraints.
